title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Tencent Releases Hy4 Preview: Tencent Hy announces Hy4, an open-source 770B parameter (49B active) frontier MoE model featuring a 1M token context window built for high-throughput productivity.

CZ Outlines Binance Hiring & Remote Execution Framework: CZ shares core principles for remote workforce success at a Hong Kong university talk, highlighting proactive execution, deep focus, and rigorous risk management.
